title: Crash-report upload debounce
oneLine: When the localStorage crash ring is uploaded: slow and fast timers plus a dedupe on the ring's length.
topConcern: Once the 16-entry ring is full its length never changes, so after the boot upload no later crash in that page is sent.

title: Page alive mark and killed-page detection
oneLine: A 5 s alive mark per page, removed on pagehide; the next page pings and reports pages that died open.
topConcern: One shared key: with two tabs open the other tab overwrites the mark, so a killed tab usually goes unreported.

title: WebGL context-loss escalation
oneLine: A context loss stamps __btGlLostAt and arms a 2.5 s rebuild through BroTown's debounced rebuild door.

title: Debug bus and overlay
oneLine: Debug console enabled and visible flags, permanent console and socket hooks, socket status, activation gesture.
topConcern: ?debug=1 without ?dev=1 turns full socket and console capture on with no overlay mounted to show or close it.

title: Perf diagnostics (zone stats, spike log, HUD)
oneLine: Per-zone frame-time epochs, a 500 ms spike-log throttle, global timer hooks and the perf HUD interval.

title: Gather-node snapshot self-heal
oneLine: Stashes a node snapshot that raced the zone flip; re-sends the move up to four times for an empty zone.
topConcern: A stash for an unentered zone lingers; the reclaim re-sends moves the worker never answers with a snapshot.

title: A peer's look across join and relay roads
oneLine: One rename table maps wire cosmetic keys onto peers: snapshots in full, the 2 s track relay as deltas.
topConcern: A pattern or drawing cleared mid-session never clears on peers; documented, and unreachable in the world today.

title: A ground-loot pile on this phone
oneLine: Local copies of worker piles: dropped, claimed, despawned, expired, with owner-only windows re-based on arrival.

title: Other players' campfires and chop targets
oneLine: Relayed peer campfires with capped fuses, extended while they cook, and a peer's chop tree; cleared per zone.

title: A dungeon run on this phone
oneLine: Opening, inside, waves, boss, 30 s clear and leaving, across about fifteen S fields and a synthetic zone.
topConcern: Three hand-written exits reset different subsets; the Workshop's skip the lock clear, zone fx, art release and delayed zone drop.

title: A monster's telegraph and visual phases
oneLine: Wind-up, swell, burrow, throw, enrage, transform and split stamps per monster, from four families of writers.
topConcern: _burstUntil is a truthy flag, not a clock: a missed execute leaves a slime swollen and untouchable, into its next life.

title: A monster's life on this phone
oneLine: Alive, dead, respawned mirror of a server monster; kill event and tick both flip it; resets by hand.
topConcern: The respawn reset omits the newer moment fields; only the swell sticks (see N2-11).

title: Another player's action stand-ins
oneLine: Timed stamps for a peer's swing, bash, whirlwind, bow, cast, roll and jump, plus a boolean raised shield.
topConcern: A peer's shield is lowered only by a relay that is dropped while they are in another zone, so it can stay up forever.

title: A monster's blow on me, as this phone shows it
oneLine: The display verdict per monster_attack: ghost filters, worker block, local fallback block, dodge, death window, defense XP.
topConcern: The fallback block re-judges blows the worker landed while the phone's shield is up: number hidden, HP still drops, defense trained.

title: Another player's corpse
oneLine: _isDead set by a peer's death relay, cleared by their respawn relay or the renderer's moved-away self-heal.

title: Clan invite and clan war on the phone
oneLine: Pending clan invite, the clan data echo and the phone's war record with scores and a 10 s end timer.
topConcern: Clans are parties now; the legacy self-score and self-pay paths would mint coins against a worker without caps.clans.

title: A blow between two players and its bookkeeping
oneLine: pvp_hit drawn on both sides, a 5 s server-resolved stamp, the defender's pvp_confirmed relay, the parry stagger.
topConcern: The attacker's KILL! and kill count come only from the defender's relayed pvp_confirmed, though pvp_hit carries the worker's died.

title: A duel on this phone
oneLine: Challenge card, optimistic accept, in-duel state and lock, arena match, ended; mirrors the worker's duel machine.
topConcern: Accept enters the duel before the worker answers; a stale or busy challenge is dropped silently, leaving the phone in a duel.

title: Threat skulls from the threat handshake
oneLine: Red and white threat skulls on me and on peers from the pvp_threat handshake, with consent windows.
topConcern: Dormant; reviving it gives the skull slots two writers (No man's land nulls them) and a plain-object id map.

title: The two-sided trade window
oneLine: One window slot driven by worker snapshots: incoming card, waiting invite, open, done receipt, failed, cancelled.
topConcern: A cancel names no invite, so an old invite's expiry or decline wipes a newer card or the player's own waiting drawer.

title: The old one-sided trade relay
oneLine: trade_offer card, trade_accept completion, trade_reject, and a local mint for an unsettled accept.
topConcern: The unsettled branch credits the giver what they gave; reachable only against a pre-v2.3.1119 worker.

title: The party invite card and the roster
oneLine: Invite stub cleared by a mirrored 60 s timer with an identity check; roster from worker snapshots.
topConcern: PARTY_INVITE_TTL_MS hand-mirrors PARTY.INVITE_TTL with no mirror-audit pin.

title: Mail arriving: daily toast wait and gear catch-up
oneLine: A bounded 90 s wait to show the daily reward toast; returned gear adopted into the local stash.

title: One-time move of old local friends to the server
oneLine: bt_friendsMigrated flag, set after sending up to 25 friend requests for legacy local follows.
topConcern: Follows past the 25th are dropped silently; one shot per device.

title: Hazard markers and effect queues
oneLine: Telegraph and impact rings, fire trail, shockwaves and blasts as timed, capped queues drained by renderers.
topConcern: Telegraph rings carry no zone and the worker's unclamped duration, so one can briefly outlive a zone change.
